patch_list: Disable Firebase analytics and remote config
No-ops the app's FirebaseAnalytics event logger and the startup RemoteConfig fetch (no FID, no config phone-home).
Disable Pairip integrity and license checks
Removes the signature-tamper crash and the Play-licensing error dialog and shutdown that fire without Google Play services.
Forces the app's own "purchased" preference on at process start and neutralizes the billing re-verify that erases it without Play services.
